name: Family Reunification (Spouse of a Dominican via RT-9; Dependent of a Resident via RT-7)

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of a Dominican national (via Ordinary Temporary Residence RT-9)

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage certificate required; applies through the standard Ordinary Temporary Residence (RT-9) process.
Financial solvency threshold is reduced to RD$150,000 (from the standard RD$300,000) when the applicant is married to a Dominican national.
requirements.fix_path: Show a Dominican bank balance of at least RD$150,000.

requirement_groups.name: Dependent of an RT-3 (work) or RT-4 (religious) resident

requirements.blocker_text: Applies through the RT-7 Dependent Temporary Residence process, tied to a principal holder's RT-3 (labor) or RT-4 (religious) status.
Requires an apostilled and judicially translated birth certificate and, where applicable, marriage certificate proving the family tie.

evidence_required.document: Apostilled, translated marriage or birth certificate proving family tie
Medical exam from a DGM-authorized institution

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Ordinary Temporary Residence (RT-9): reduced RD$150,000 solvency threshold when married to a Dominican national (vs. standard RD$300,000)
Dirección General de Migración -- Dependent Temporary Residence (RT-7): for dependents of RT-3 (labor) and RT-4 (religious) principal holders, 1-year validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). There is no single DGM page titled a generic 'family reunification' or 'spouse' visa -- the actual mechanism for a spouse of a Dominican is the standard RT-9 Ordinary Temporary Residence permit, which simply carries a reduced solvency threshold when the applicant is married to a Dominican national; this is the tier-1-confirmed evidence that a distinct, easier path exists for spouses, even though it is not a separately named route in DGM's own service catalogue. Separately, RT-7 exists specifically for dependents of RT-3/RT-4 holders (not spouses of citizens) -- the source does not define 'dependent' precisely or confirm whether it includes spouses of RT-3/RT-4 holders themselves; flagged as a gap rather than guessed. citizenship_after_months left null for this route since the spouse path's exact timeline runs through do_citizenship_by_marriage, whose duration requirement is itself unconfirmed in current practice (see that file's notes).
